claim_as_stated: MS GIFT Donor Circular (Aug 2024) publicly linked from msgift.donorfirstx.com; grants by mail/bank details; statements view-only; no outbound-transfer terms
exact_values_found: Portal home links /pdf/MSGIFT/Donor Circular and Disclosure Statement.pdf; cover 'August 2024'; grants 'sent to the organization utilizing its validated mailing address or banking details. Each grant must be at least $250'; ~10 business days; 'Provide viewing access of the Account via the Online Portal'; donor 'may view grant disbursements ... including within the quarterly Account statements'; only asset-movement clauses are dormant/no-successor transfers to MS GIFT undesignated fund
discrepancies: None material. Circular says 'viewing access', not literally 'view-only'
interpretation_challenge: 'banking details' means electronic payment exists; do not read MS GIFT as check-only. 'View-only' is an inference from absence of any export/download clause, not an explicit restriction. Circular also bars grants to private non-operating foundations but is silent on grants to other DAF sponsors (absence of outbound clause != prohibition)

entity: Bank of America Charitable Gift Fund
claim_as_stated: Check-only grant payment (2024 guidelines; 2024-25 portal guides); portal on Ren DFX with Ren mailboxes; contribution (not grant) Excel export; balance may go 'to another donor-advised fund' only if BofA terminates advisory rights
source_date: Guidelines v3.2024 (3/2024); 'Making the Most' sheet 8/2024; Navigating guide 9/2025
exact_values_found: 'Grants are issued via checks bearing the name of Bank of America Charitable Gift Fund. Checks will only be delivered directly to the legal mailing address ... USPS first class mail'; sheet: 'sends all grant checks via USPS first class mail'; 2025 guide 'check number and date cleared'; portal https://bofa.donorfirst.org/ comment 'Renaissance, powered by RenPSG', image Powered_by_REN, cdndfx.donorfirstx.com script, mailto charitablegiftfund@reninc.com; guide: paper grants to donations_cgf@reninc.com; 'You can export to Excel' on Contribution Listing only; Termination clause: Donor/Advisor 'may make a grant recommendation to a Qualified Organization or grant the remaining assets to another donor-advised fund'
discrepancies: Portal host is bofa.donorfirst.org (DonorFirst), assets served from donorfirstx.com CDN
interpretation_challenge: 'Only if' overstates the restriction: Qualified Organization = 509(a)(1)/(2)/(3) public charities, which includes national DAF sponsors, so ordinary grants to another sponsor are not expressly barred. The termination clause is the only EXPLICIT DAF-to-DAF wording, not an exclusive permission

claim_as_stated: PayPal Grant Payments used by NPT (up to $250k) and Vanguard Charitable (up to $10M per 2023 release); Charityvest switched to Chariot Aug 2026; AEF pays ACH via Ren portal; DAFgiving360 and BofA check only
source_date: NPT guide (PDF metadata 2026-10-15); Vanguard release Sept 2023; Chariot article 2026; AEF page live; DAFgiving360 2024 policies
exact_values_found: NPT: 'Grants of up to $250,000 will be processed via Grant Payments (electronic funds transfer via PayPal) or check'; wires only for $250,000+. Vanguard 2023 release: 'grants up to $10 million at no cost'; launched May 2023, >$130m to >400 charities. Chariot: 'Starting August 2026, Charityvest is transitioning to Chariot Disbursements'; 'By the end of Charityvest's transition ... all grant payments will be sent via Chariot'. AEF: 'Powered by Ren' charity portal charities.rengiving.com, ACH; check until verified. DAFgiving360 2024 policies: 'makes grants by issuing checks'. BofA 2024: checks only
discrepancies: Charityvest 'switched' overstates: source says transitioning from Aug 2026; Charityvest's own charity guide (guide.charityvest.org) still says 'Whenever possible, Charityvest delivers grants via Grant Payments with PayPal'
contradictory_evidence: Charityvest guide still PayPal (stale or transition incomplete)
interpretation_challenge: NPT's $250k is NPT's processing band, not a PayPal product cap (Vanguard $10M). DAFgiving360 'check only' rests on 2024 policies; dafgiving360.org returned 403 so the 2026 state is unverified
